name: tx3-skills
description: Tx3 language and trix toolchain support for Codex: the tx3-language and tx3-project skills plus the local tx3-mcp server.

interface.longDescription: Write, check and inspect Tx3 transaction templates for Cardano. The tx3-language skill teaches the language surface; the tx3-project skill covers trix projects, profiles and tests. The local tx3-mcp server parses, checks, lowers and inspects your project. Requires tx3-mcp and trix on PATH, installed with tx3up.
defaultPrompt: What must my application supply to call this protocol's transactions?
Check this Tx3 project for errors.
Explain what this transaction consumes and produces.
